_comment: Absurd human units for the verdict line. Break-even tokens are converted to counts of these. Word counts are public figures; tokens are derived at the stated tokens_per_word so the conversion is traceable. Add units freely: each needs a singular, a plural, and either 'tokens' directly or 'words'.
tokens_per_word_note: Rough English average for modern BPE tokenisers; OpenAI's rule of thumb is ~0.75 words per token.
